title: helictotrichon pubescens var. alpinum
intro: Helictotrichon pubescens var. alpinum, commonly known as Alpine Blue Grass, is a type of ornamental grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is known to have several health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory function. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Blue Grass include its potential to act as an antispasmodic and anti-inflammatory agent, which may help in managing conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
